_comment: Cells that are known to be wrong and must not be in the data. Keyed by locale, then scientific name; value is the wrong value, reason says why. cmd/import-taxonomy never imports a listed BirdNET+ Taxonomy cell while upstream still has that value (compared case-insensitively), and an excluded en cell becomes the scientific name. scripts/validate.py fails when a listed value is present in the data.
